title: Paired H-to-A protected two-member finalization intake (draft)
description: Paired verb stage2a-member-finalization carries all seven exact Stage2aStopRequest selectors plus the reopened canonical H JCS finalization record bytes as canonical unpadded base64url and their SHA-256. H must fsync and read back its durable record before request. A strict-decodes the exact H bytes (at most 8192 bytes), checks canonical JCS, digest, cached A-signed records, both members and live roles, then issues its separate signed acknowledgement. The complete request must be at most 16384 JCS UTF-8 bytes. Neither H's self-asserted B relay socket tuple nor a birthtime absent independent observation is treated as measured authority.
